title: Demo Quiz: All Features
description: Demo set for keyboard flow, single and multi-select, hints, explanations, and clipboard copy.

questions.prompt: Single choice question. Which key starts selected quiz from list screen?
questions.explanation: In list screen, enter starts selected quiz. Space also works.

questions.prompt: Multi-select question. Pick all keys that move between questions in quiz screen.
questions.hint: Think vim keys and arrow aliases.
questions.explanation: App supports h/l and left/right, plus p/n aliases for prev/next.

questions.prompt: Question without hint field. Toggle hint and see fallback text.
questions.explanation: If hint missing, UI shows fallback text: No hint available.

questions.prompt: Question without explanation field. Submit answer then toggle explanation.
Valid choice count is 2 to 8. This question uses max supported choices.
questions.explanation: Quiz loader validates each question with 2-8 choices.

questions.prompt: Which key combo copies current question text and options to clipboard?
questions.hint: Double key press within short interval.
questions.explanation: App listens for double y and shows toast with clipboard result.
